outcome: avoidance of reflection in the mirror
cohort: 12,199 female subjects, including 3,329 women self-reporting Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS), from a Middle Eastern population.
finding: Women with PCOS reported significantly lower measures of self-esteem and body image satisfaction compared to women without PCOS in this population.
cross-section timing: Current self-reported psychological well-being and body image satisfaction via an online survey for women of childbearing age.
